The phone\'s speech recognition

To turn your voice into text, this phone uses its speech recognition service, which may send your voice to its vendor\'s service (for example, Google). AINGEL doesn\'t control or store that audio. Your decision is recorded for your account only and you can withdraw it at any time in More → Authorizations. You can also type instead.
